preservation.comparison: Exact per-paragraph multisets; complete sibling phrases may move with translated word order. Renderer independently enforces marker uniqueness, pairing and original parent relationships.

runs.transport: Direct Chromium extension → Magpie, without recording relay.

method: 977 English words, 16 paragraphs, original Wikipedia markup, Simplified Chinese. Clean Chromium profile and extension cache disabled for every run. Timer starts at page.start and ends when all 16 paragraphs have rendered. Includes model calls, scheduling and rendering, excludes browser/page load. Qualification repeats are sequential with no other model benchmark running.
scope: Browser structural completeness plus one manual source/translation review; not a service-level guarantee or a claim that all models/pages finish within five seconds.
limitations: Direct repeat does not expose upstream usage; its caching status is unknown.
Traced repeat 2 reports prompt cache hits; initial qualifying run reports zero prompt cache hits. No application translation cache was used.
Earlier failing iterations are retained and are never counted as completed translations.
Reference commercial provider speed was not measured; previous Mac/AGY timing is historical and not a controlled speedup baseline.

Translated sibling phrase order is allowed to change. Exact marker multiplicity, tag pairs, original parent relationships, per-paragraph link/format multisets and source restoration are still required.

manualReview.result: No whole-paragraph omissions found in the inspected source/translation pairs; central facts, dates and citations retained. Minor literal phrasing remains, particularly paragraphs 10–12. Proper names and the quoted English idiom are sometimes retained in English. This is one review, not exhaustive semantic quality certification.
